About the ingredients: Bakuchiol has been studied in topical creams for the appearance of fine lines and uneven pigmentation. One trial used a 0.5% cream. This mix-in serum has a different formula and application method, so the trial does not establish the same outcome here.
Research cited here concerns ingredients or other formulations, not a clinical trial of this CELDYQUE product. Dhaliwal et al. — Topical bakuchiol and photoageing
